cases.title: Synthetic randomized analgesia study
cases.source_text: Synthetic benchmark abstract. In a multicentre, assessor-blinded randomized trial, 612 adults after major abdominal surgery received low-dose ketamine or placebo in addition to standard multimodal analgesia. Median 24-hour opioid consumption was 42 mg versus 47 mg morphine equivalents (difference -5 mg; 95% CI -9 to -1). Severe pain occurred in 31% versus 35%. Hallucinations occurred in 8% versus 2%. The trial was not powered for mortality or rare harms.

cases.title: Synthetic observational ventilation study
cases.source_text: Synthetic benchmark abstract. A retrospective multicentre cohort included 18,420 mechanically ventilated adults. Early mobilization was associated with lower hospital mortality after measured adjustment (adjusted odds ratio 0.82; 95% CI 0.74 to 0.91). Treatment assignment was not randomized, mobilization exposure was incompletely measured, and residual confounding is likely. The study supports an association and cannot establish a causal mortality benefit.

cases.title: Synthetic ultrasound-guided access commentary
cases.source_text: Synthetic benchmark excerpt. This is an educational commentary describing a practical checklist for ultrasound-guided peripheral intravenous access. It contains no original patient data, no comparison group, and no systematic review. The author recommends local simulation and competency assessment before independent use.
